2609.08755.title: Kairos: A Dataset for Fine-Grained Video-Language Modeling over Space, Time, and Dynamics
2609.08755.paper_summary: Many emerging video language modeling tasks require systems to move beyond clip-level abstraction and model visual content as it unfolds over extended time horizons. However, most existing video datasets rely on coarse or sparsely aligned supervision, which compresses temporal variation and limits the ability of models to learn reusable representations of continuous visual dynamics. We introduce Kairos, a video dataset for video-language modeling with time-resolved annotations. Kairos consists of long-duration videos, ranging from ten minutes to half an hour, annotated with fine-grained temporal alignment. The annotations capture ongoing actions, entity appearances and attributes, interactions, and evolving contextual cues along the video timeline. This time-resolved structure supports fine-grained evaluation, long-range modeling and reasoning, instruction data construction, representation learning, and video generation. Kairos provides a general-purpose foundation for modeling visual experiences over time.
2609.08755.paper_summary_zh: 許多新興的視頻語言建模任務需要系統超越片段級別的抽象，並隨著時間的延續來建模視覺內容。然後，大多數現有的視頻數據集依賴於粗略或稀疏對齊的監督，這壓縮了時間變化，限制了模型學習可重用的連續視覺動態表示的能力。我們介紹了Kairos，一個用於視頻語言建模的視頻數據集，具有時間解析的標註。Kairos由長時間視頻組成，長度從十分鐘到半小時，並帶有細粒度的時間對齊標註。這些標註捕捉了持續的行動、實體的出現和屬性、互動以及沿著視頻時間線演變的上下文線索。這種時間解析結構支持細粒度評估、長期建模和推理、指令數據構建、表示學習和視頻生成。Kairos為隨時間建模視覺體驗提供了一個通用的基礎。
